{{Top|leg}}
'''TOL-type ore''' was a variety of [[Ore/Legends|ore]] that was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[244Core]], in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. At some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, the company [[Tor-Ro-Bo Industries]] hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggle]] some semi-processed TOL-type ore from an [[Tor-Ro-Bo Processing Center 879|ore processing facility]] on 244Core to the [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] ''[[Tor 7863]]'', in breach of a [[Profit-Sharing Agreement Relaali 374.5.2|profit-sharing agreement]] that Tor-Ro-Bo had signed with the other corporations that operated on 244Core. The smugglers arrived at the facility and proceeded to load the illicit ore onto their [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. However, the [[Eeook Corporation]] and a number of the other signatories to the trade agreement learned of Tor-Ro-Bo's violation of the contract, and they sent some security forces to the processing facility to prevent the smugglers from leaving 244Core with the ore. However, the spacers evaded the security forces and successfully transported the TOL-type ore to ''Tor 7863''.<ref name="Imminent Impact">''{{WizCite|story=Imminent Impact|book=The Unknown Regions}}''</ref>
